map.CE 对概率错误更敏感且在 sigmoid/softmax 下梯度更优，MSE: CE is more sensitive to probability errors and gives better gradients under sigmoid/softmax, while MSE applied to probabilities saturates and converges slowly; CE is the natural log-likelihood loss for classification.
map.CE 对错误预测惩罚重(对数放大)，是分类模型训练的标准损失。: CE penalizes wrong predictions heavily (logarithmic amplification), which makes it the standard loss for training classification models.
map.log(0) 得 −∞ 导致数值爆炸。实践中对 p 做裁剪(clip 到 ε~1: log(0) gives -inf and makes the numbers explode. In practice clip p (to the range eps to 1-eps) or use a stable implementation with logits (feeding raw scores straight into softmax).
map.p 为 0 或 1 会怎样？: What happens when p is 0 or 1?
map.→ 打开交叉熵损失工具: -> Open the cross entropy loss tool
map.为什么用交叉熵而不是均方误差？: Why use cross entropy instead of mean squared error?
map.二分类交叉熵 CE=−[y·log(p)+(1−y)·log(1−p)]，y∈{: Binary cross entropy CE = -[y*log(p) + (1-y)*log(1-p)], with y in {0,1} and p the predicted probability of the positive class.
map.二分类交叉熵对 confident 且错误的预测给出极大惩罚（p→0 而 y=1: Binary cross entropy penalizes confident wrong predictions extremely heavily (it diverges as p->0 while y=1), its gradient takes the clean form (p - y), and back-propagating through sigmoid is very tidy. When implementing, clip p with an eps to avoid log(0).
map.单样本 L = −[y·ln p + (1 − y)·ln(1 − p)]；批量: Single-sample L = -[y*ln p + (1 - y)*ln(1 - p)]; batch L = single sample x n
map.多分类用 −Σyᵢlog(pᵢ)，要求 p 经 softmax 且和为 1。: Multi-class uses -sum(y_i*log(p_i)), which requires p to pass through softmax and sum to 1.
map.输入真实标签与预测概率，计算二分类交叉熵损失，评估模型预测偏差，适用于机器学习训: Enter the true label and the predicted probability to compute the binary cross entropy loss and assess the deviation of the model prediction, for machine learning training monitoring, loss debugging and classification model evaluation.
map.：真实 y=1，预测 p=0.9 → CE=−log(0.9)=0.105；若: : true y=1, predicted p=0.9 -> CE=-log(0.9)=0.105; if p=0.1 -> CE=-log(0.1)=2.303. The worse the prediction, the larger the loss, which drives the model to correct itself.
